# provisioned

A fixture floe in the resources camp: mints a value and writes a local file.

<!-- Generated by nix/floe-interface.nix. Refresh: nix run .#refresh-floe-docs -->

## Inputs

| input | type | default | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| publishTo | null or (submodule) | `null` | Where the generated credential is published, or null to generate it and let it stay in state.  This is the join between the two camps (RFC 0003 §7) and the easiest thing in the design to get wrong: a publication writes into a store the lab already declares, and a cluster reads it back with the `secrets.subscribe` it already has. There is no second addressing scheme, because a second one would be understood by neither side.  |
| stateDir | string | `"/tmp/catallaxy-provisioned"` | Directory the `local` resources write into.  A real resource would name a cloud account here. This names a path, because the point of the fixture is the machinery around the resource rather than the resource.  |

## Requires

| hole | signature | what it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| cluster | KUBERNETES_CLUSTER | The cluster a member installs into: its name, version, context and address ranges. |

## Emits

| alias | kind | what it carries |
| --- | --- | --- |
| publications | catallaxy.publications | Where a resource's output lands once it exists, as an address in a lab secret store. |
| resources | catallaxy.resources | Infrastructure declared for a state-based tool to create, for the case no cluster can own it. |
